summary: LORÉ v3 (personas + message versions/regenerate/edit). Backend: 51/51 pass (30 regression + 21 new). Frontend: persona pages render, sidebar nav-personas link works, persona picker visible in chat header, but several data-testids in the spec are not present in the rendered DOM, blocking automated verification of regenerate/edit/version arrows.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='persona-picker' is NOT on the pill button. The picker pill ('A Aria' top-right of chat header) renders correctly but cannot be located by spec-mandated testid. Add data-testid='persona-picker' to the trigger and data-testid='persona-option-none' / 'persona-option-{id}' / 'persona-create-link' to dropdown items.

Character/user message bubbles render as data-testid='message-{n}' (11 found) instead of role-prefixed testids 'message-character-{id}' / 'message-user-{id}'. As a result, hover-revealed buttons cannot be linked to a specific message id. Recommend: data-testid='message-character-{messageId}' on the bubble + data-testid='msg-regenerate-{messageId}', 'msg-edit-{messageId}', 'msg-edit-textarea-{messageId}', 'msg-edit-save-{messageId}', 'msg-edit-cancel-{messageId}', 'msg-version-prev-{messageId}', 'msg-version-next-{messageId}', 'msg-version-counter-{messageId}'.
data-testid='persona-definition-counter' not detected; counter element using '/ 32000' text not found in DOM scan. Add data-testid to counter so amber-at-90% threshold can be asserted automatically.

Inputs lack name attributes and stable data-testids (Name input only locatable by placeholder='Aria Chen'). Add data-testid='persona-name-input', 'persona-definition-input', 'persona-save-btn' for reliable testing.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to PersonaPicker trigger + dropdown items: 'persona-picker', 'persona-option-none', 'persona-option-{id}', 'persona-create-link'.
Add data-testid='persona-card-{id}' on persona list cards and 'persona-create-btn' on '+ New Persona' (button currently labelled 'New Persona' has no testid).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~960 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth, files, characters, chat, personas, messages).
Persona DELETE correctly unsets active_persona_id in chat_settings (verified).
_ensure_versions backfill is idempotent and applied in both list_messages and PATCH path.
Regenerate uses history strictly < created_at of message — correct so the new variant is for the same turn.
Definition >32000 properly rejected on POST and PUT; boundary 32000 accepted (verified).

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (pages render and login/nav/persona-list work; testid mismatches blocked deeper UI assertions for regenerate/edit/version arrows)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create transient TEST_ users + characters + personas, all cleaned up at end of suite. Frontend test created an additional persona named 'TEST_UIPersona' under test@lore.app — main agent should clean up if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is 100% green for v3. New tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_personas_messages.py (21 tests, ~19s wall). Run both files with pytest. For the frontend, the spec listed specific testids (persona-picker, message-character-{id}, msg-regenerate-{id}, msg-edit-{id}, persona-definition-counter) that are NOT implemented; the actual DOM uses message-{n} numbering and unnamed buttons. Once main agent adds the testids, retest hover->regenerate, hover->edit, version arrows, picker dropdown, definition 29k amber state. Persona picker pill IS visible in chat header (top-right, currently shows 'A Aria').
rca of the issue: No backend bugs. Frontend testid coverage is incomplete relative to the spec — interactive elements for new features (persona picker, message regenerate/edit, version arrows, persona form fields, persona definition counter) lack data-testid attributes, making automated UI verification infeasible without DOM heuristics.
